info.name: PromoQuoter API
info.description: Cart pricing and stock reservation service. Run the folders in order (or use the Collection Runner): the create requests save ids into collection variables that later requests use. Start the service first with ./mvnw spring-boot:run (http://localhost:8080). Promotions are rules (conditions, a target and an action): the Promotions folder shows percent off, buy X get Y, tiered bulk, conditions, validation, gifts, cart-level discounts, surcharges, stopAfter and preview, and the Cart folder shows them in quotes and orders. The Cleanup folder deletes the promotions so the run can be repeated. Every error is an RFC 7807 problem with code, requestId and errors[].

request.description: A promotion is a rule: optional "when" (checked once per cart), optional "target" (checked per line) and one "action". Conditions combine with all, any and not and compare with eq, ne, gt, gte, lt, lte, between, in, notIn, startsWith and contains. Here: 10 percent off every kitchen product (PERCENT_OFF, stage 100). Saves percentPromoId. This collection uses the generic RULE payload; the classic shortcut payloads (PERCENT_OFF_CATEGORY, BUY_X_GET_Y, TIERED_BULK) are still accepted and are described in the README.
